expected_legal_description:
TRACT #1: BEGINNING in the Northwesterly line of Euclid Avenue  
80 feet Southwesterly from the Westerly corner of Euclid and  
Turnley Avenues; thence Southwesterly along the Northwesterly  
line of Euclid Avenue 80 feet in width or breadth; thence Northwest-  
wardly between parallel lines, parallel with Turnley Avenue 142 feet  
in length or depth.

TRACT #2: BEGINNING at a point in the boundary line of premises  
owned by the party of the first part which beginning point is  
located on the Northerly line of Euclid Avenue, distant 160 feet  
Westwardly along said line from its intersection with the Westerly  
line of Turnley Avenue; and extends thence (1) Westwardly along  
said Northerly line of Euclid Avenue a distance of 10 feet to  
a point; and extends thence (2) Northwardly parallel with the  
Westerly line of Turnley Avenue making an interior angle of 89  
degrees, 43 minutes 30 seconds with the preceding course the dis-  
tance of 142 feet to a point; and extends thence (3) Eastwardly par-  
allel with the first course the distance of 10 feet to an angle  
in the boundary line of property of the party of the first part;  
and extends thence (4) Southwardly parallel with the second course  
along a party of the first part's said boundary line the distance  
of 142 feet to the point of beginning.
